title: Return by Death
description: This mod adds the return by death ablity from rezero
body:
## Warning: **this mod manuplates save data and nbt by actualty removing or changing files as such always keep a backup of you saves before installing this mod.** # Return By Death This mod adds the ablity to retun to the last checkpoint by dying.
Unlike normal minecraft where you retun to your last respawnpoint , in this mod you go back in time to the last checkpoint So all mobs you might have killed will be alive , the blocks you broke will also be placed one again, your inventory will also reset. You now have the power to know the future, act wisely and hope the next loop does't start you at your worst. A new checkpoint is saved every 20 mins , yep you can't choose so hope that fate favours you
## things that have been updated - Added new checkpoints - New Advancement - Bed - 20 Min( every minecraft day) New featurs: - Added two mods - Normal: In this mode you get the death screen - Immediate( like anime) enable immediate respawn and then immediatly return to death - Added SFX when returned to death Demo:
